summary: Schedule fields are name, description, start date/time and time zone; jobs are scheduled in UTC and daily times can shift with Daylight Saving Time, so set schedules in UTC.
questions: Why did my scheduled job run an hour off after daylight saving time?
What time zone are controller schedules stored in?
How do I set a schedule's time zone?

answer_card.title: Schedules and daylight saving time
answer_card.answer_md: Controller stores schedules in **UTC**. The local start time you enter is converted to UTC when you save, so a repeating job at a fixed time of day can move by an hour relative to local time when Daylight Saving Time changes. To avoid surprises, define schedules in UTC.
